Pricing

Priced per order, because that's what you're protecting.

Start free against test data. Move to a paid plan when real travellers' money is flowing through it. One caught failure usually costs more than the month.

Questions people actually ask

What counts as one reconciliation?

One order, judged once. Re-checking the same order after the supplier finally confirms — which the watcher does on its own — does not count again. You are billed for orders, not API calls.

What happens when I go over the included volume?

Nothing breaks. Overage is billed at the per-order rate on the plan. Relay will never stop reconciling mid-month, because the month you exceed your plan is exactly the month you need it working.

Can I stay on Sandbox forever?

Yes. Sandbox keys, test data, all ten rules, no card, no expiry. It becomes limiting the moment you want live keys, webhooks or the watcher.

Do I have to sign in to pay?

Yes — deliberately. A subscription attaches to a workspace, and a workspace only exists once you have an account. Choosing a paid plan while signed out will send you to sign in first and then bring you straight back here.

Is there a discount for design partners?

Design partners are free during the pilot, and we agree pricing afterwards based on what Relay actually caught. If you have real order volume and are willing to look at findings with us, say so here.

Larger volume, or something that doesn't fit?

Annual contracts, on-premise deployment, custom detection rules, procurement paperwork and security review — all normal, none of it self-serve.
